step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Symmetric Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) / Multiplier
step1_analysis.description: A fully symmetric OTA featuring two differential input pairs sharing a diode-connected PMOS load and parallel PMOS current sources. It is typically used as a tunable transconductor in high-frequency continuous-time filters or as a delay cell in a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO).

paper_reference.title: An Enhanced Adaptive Q-Tuning Scheme for a 100-MHz Fully Symmetric OTA-Based Bandpass Filter

sky130_expected.calculation: gm1 = 375 uA/V, gm_load = 178 uA/V. Gain = gm1/gm_load = 2.1 V/V = 6.4 dB. (40 dB in paper likely refers to the full filter Q-enhanced gain, not a single stage)
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected loads inherently provide low gain (~gm/gm). High gain requires cross-coupling or cascading.

Bandwidth_3dB.description: Frequency at which the gain drops by 3 dB from its DC value

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout = 1/gm_load = 5.6 kOhm. Cload = 10 fF. BW = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cload) = 2.8 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low output impedance from diode loads pushes the pole to very high frequencies, suitable for >100MHz operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 105 uA per pair. Total current ~250 uA. Power = 250 uA * 1.8 V = 0.45 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the applied bias voltages (N4, N5). Adjusted for typical 1.8V SKY130 operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, 3dB bandwidth, and power consumption of the OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N5 LABEL_NET_4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 LABEL_NET_5 N4 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N2 LABEL_NET_6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N4 LABEL_NET_7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Override dummy 0.9V sources with proper supply/ground
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 0

* Bias voltages for tail current and PMOS loads
VN4 N4 0 0.7
VN5 N5 0 1.1

* Inputs
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.1 100Meg)
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 0.9 ac 0
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9

* Load capacitance
C1 N2 0 10f
C2 N3 0 10f

.control
op
let power = (-i(VVDD) - i(VLABEL_NET_4) - i(VLABEL_NET_6)) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let vout_diff = v(N3) - v(N2)
let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain-3' fall=1

tran 10p 50n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(N3)
quit
.endc
